title: Category:Alchemy vendors
wikitext:
This category contains NPCs that sell [[alchemy]] supplies. Most of these NPCs have one of the following titles: <Alchemist>, <Journeyman Alchemy>, <Alchemy Supplies>, <Journeyman Alchemist>, <Expert Alchemist>, <Artisan Alchemist>, but this is not a requirement. Note that many [[:Category:Herbalism vendors|Herbalism vendors]] also sell vials, but this does not automatically make them alchemy vendors.
